evidence.testTitle: ABUSE-005: actual JOIN/PART or channel-creation command burst closes only the hostile socket and preserves persistent unrelated state
evidence.scenarioScope: One authenticated hostile IRC socket submits 220 actual alternating PART/JOIN commands for an existing secret channel; the configured per-session raw-command budget closes it.
evidence.rationale: Exact passed focused test against immutable source11, genuine public-registration credentials and real sockets; test-only controls expose actual state or gate/raise inside an actual RPC without replacing queue behavior.
assertionDetails: Accepted JOIN and PART frames precede actual close1000 Excess Flood; 74 JOIN frames include the initial JOIN and the remainder is bounded by the configured150 raw commands/10s.

Closed hostile session disappears; stopped SQLite has zero Bob channel_members rows; no created-channel metadata exists. Healthy independent Alice IRC/event and outsider Charlie event sockets remain live through a shared barrier.

After secret-channel history403, both live event observers contain only the subsequent authorized barrier and no denial-induced publication. Closed Bob receives no further frames; unrelated channel members, grants and messages exactly match the seeded snapshot.
Runtime is stopped AFTER flooding, persisted state is independently read, then reconstructed; fresh Bob/Alice JOIN and real private delivery work, unrelated persistent content remains.
coverageLimitations: Only one target per raw command and one hostile session are measured; comma-target expansion, sustained windows and concurrent/reconnected-account aggregate budgets are not proved.

evidence.testTitle: ABUSE-006: actual JOIN/PART or channel-creation command burst closes only the hostile socket and preserves persistent unrelated state
evidence.scenarioScope: One authenticated hostile IRC socket submits220 one-target JOIN commands creating real channels, followed by actual Excess Flood closure and persisted channel accounting.
evidence.rationale: Exact passed focused test against immutable source11, genuine public-registration credentials and real sockets; test-only controls expose actual state or gate/raise inside an actual RPC without replacing queue behavior.
assertionDetails: 146 new channels are accepted, plus the initial protected-channel JOIN; observed JOIN frames147 and actual created-object metadata count146 remain below150. Actual close1000 Excess Flood occurs after793ms in the final trace.

Actual known_channels and independently opened stopped SQLite channel_metadata canonical_name rows match the same146 identities; no Bob membership survives. Reconstructed runtime still knows exactly those146 created identities.

Healthy independent private delivery succeeds after closure; forbidden Bob history returns403, bracketed live Alice/Charlie event observers remain silent except authorized barriers, and closed hostile socket receives nothing.

Unrelated channel members, founder grants and messages exactly match its seeded snapshot before teardown; unrelated saved content and new authorized private delivery remain valid after process reconstruction.
coverageLimitations: 146 channels persist by design of the observed implementation; this run does not establish a per-account/global/long-term storage ceiling, cleanup policy, multi-target JOIN charging or aggregate reconnect/concurrent-session creation budget. Existing generic per-session command throttle is the proved control.

evidence.testTitle: WS-020: real IRC disconnect and event close release actual socket state and event slots across reconstruction
evidence.scenarioScope: Actual abrupt TCP termination of one authenticated IRC and one event socket releases real runtime state/transport slots; replacement event/IRC connections and reconstruction work.
evidence.rationale: Exact passed focused test against immutable source11, genuine public-registration credentials and real sockets; test-only controls expose actual state or gate/raise inside an actual RPC without replacing queue behavior.
assertionDetails: Five real Bob event sockets upgrade101 and the sixth is429; terminating one lowers actual ctx event count5to4 and a fresh authorized event connection upgrades101 and restores5.

Terminating Bob IRC produces actual peer QUIT, removes its actual session, session_channels and monitor rows, removes ChannelDO membership, and lowers actual ctx.getWebSockets live transport slots8to7.

Closed IRC/event frame counts do not increase through subsequent private publication. A still-live replacement event socket receives no private message while Bob lacks membership, then receives the allowed message after fresh Bob JOIN; fresh IRC receives it too.

Unrelated channel members/grants/messages remain identical. After process reconstruction event socket count is0, fresh authenticated IRC/events deliver private content, and outsider history403 is bracketed by live authorized/outsider event barrier silence.
coverageLimitations: Abrupt Node TCP termination and process reconstruction are proved; the earlier graceful close handshake wait was unresolved fixture diagnostics, not accepted graceful-handshake coverage. Event API has account-authorized streams rather than client-selected channel subscription requests; no such feature is invented. No2000-connection saturation run is claimed.

evidence.testTitle: WS-021 ABUSE-012: actual IRC output bytes are bounded while one real authorization RPC is pending and healthy recipients progress
evidence.scenarioScope: Bound actual production IRC application output queue bytes under a held real authorization RPC, with1008 closure and independent healthy delivery; native transport bounds remain incomplete.
evidence.rationale: Exact passed focused test against immutable source11, genuine public-registration credentials and real sockets; test-only controls expose actual state or gate/raise inside an actual RPC without replacing queue behavior.
assertionDetails: Two real producer accounts use16 separately authenticated IRC devices, each below its configured raw-command budget. Valid message-tags padding and400-byte bodies produce actual forwarded private frames; each producer message is independently received on healthy Charlie IRC.

Only actual Bob AccountsDO.getAccountByUsername is held after the real account lookup; original production sendLine/flushOutbound are unchanged. Actual queue sampling observes8,384,250 pending bytes and1917 queued frames, including the in-flight batch byte accounting; the next frame closes Bob1008 Output queue limit reached.

1919 accepted producer messages carry8,117,370 input bytes; one real authorization RPC reaches the test gate. This producer-byte number is distinct from actual queue bytes. Healthy Charlie event delivery continues, outsider Dave gets no pressure contents, and403 secret-history denial has live healthy/outside event silence barriers.

Releasing the held real RPC drains actual global pending-byte count to0; unrelated channel members/grants/messages exactly match the sentinel. A fresh reconstructed runtime has0 queued bytes and new real Bob private delivery works.
coverageLimitations: This is actual application queue pressure while an authorization RPC is pending, not a non-reading IRC transport. The separate4096-frame and16MiB-global branches are not independently saturated. Provider/native IRC and event transport buffer memory ceilings and production-provider behavior remain unverified.

dimensionCoverageNotes.transport: Real sockets and application queue pressure are exercised, but the complete IRC/event native/provider slow-consumer ceiling remains required and uncredited. This omission is a coverage gap, never N/A.

evidence.testTitle: WS-021 ABUSE-012: a real paused event TCP reader resumes measured private frames while independent recipients progress without proving a provider buffer ceiling
evidence.scenarioScope: Characterize a real paused event TCP reader with128 accepted private messages, healthy recipient progress and measured resumed frames/bytes; no native buffer ceiling or throttling is established.
evidence.rationale: Exact passed focused test against immutable source11, genuine public-registration credentials and real sockets; test-only controls expose actual state or gate/raise inside an actual RPC without replacing queue behavior.
assertionDetails: A live actual Bob event WebSocket first receives an authorized private marker, then its actual Node TCP reader is paused.128 genuine private REST messages are accepted and persist by matching saved ID/content;1,048,448 request content bytes are delivered to independent healthy IRC/event recipients.

While paused, Bob application frame/byte counters do not advance and the socket remains OPEN; after resume exactly128 private message frames arrive. Total post-pause received event frames130 and decoded event payload bytes1,102,896 include subsequent observer barriers and are not server memory or TCP allocation measurements.

Independent outsider Dave receives no private message; actual forbidden history403 is bracketed by live healthy/outside event barriers with no denial-generated events. Unrelated members/grants/messages match exactly.
After process reconstruction a new authorized event reader receives new private output; saved private message IDs/content and unrelated sentinel remain intact.
coverageLimitations: Finite accepted workload is a characterization, not evidence of bounded native buffering; no closure/throttle occurred. Server/provider allocation and an upper ceiling were not measurable through this public transport. Retain required transport-bound coverage gap for both broad scenarios.

dimensionCoverageNotes.transport: Real sockets and application queue pressure are exercised, but the complete IRC/event native/provider slow-consumer ceiling remains required and uncredited. This omission is a coverage gap, never N/A.

evidence.testTitle: ABUSE-013: repeated real failing account RPCs close the affected recipient with bounded attempts while healthy deliveries persist
evidence.scenarioScope: Three separate real account-authorization RPC failures on outbound IRC delivery close only the affected recipient with one observed attempt per cycle and no observed retries.
evidence.rationale: Exact passed focused test against immutable source11, genuine public-registration credentials and real sockets; test-only controls expose actual state or gate/raise inside an actual RPC without replacing queue behavior.
assertionDetails: Each cycle begins with genuine fresh Bob authentication/JOIN and an actual positive private delivery. The test then executes a real Worker SQL SELECT against a deliberately missing table inside the actual AccountsDO RPC AFTER its normal account lookup, causing a real workerd RPC exception.

Faulting publication persists but reaches no affected Bob IRC frame; actual close reason is Session delivery could not be authorized and Bob ChannelDO membership disappears. Independent Alice IRC/event delivery and outside Charlie barrier controls progress.

Three measured per-cycle fault call counts are1,1,1 with minimum250ms quiet observation after actual close and live recipient/denial event barriers; no extra attempt appears during these finite windows. Outsider secret-history403 emits no event beyond the subsequent allowed barrier.

Unrelated channel members, grants and messages remain identical. Saved fault-message IDs/content are independently read from actual Worker state and again after process reconstruction; fresh Bob authentication/private delivery succeeds.
coverageLimitations: Fault injection covers only outbound account-authorization RPC. It is not exhaustive coverage of all RPC call sites, provider outages, backoff policies or indefinite time; minimum quiet observation is250ms per cycle.
